name: Brass Or Copper
overview: Scripture reveals that brass or copper held significant value in ancient Israelite worship and daily life, being extensively used for altars, temple vessels, and household items as seen in the detailed inventory of metals including brass commanded by the LORD through Moses (Numbers 31:21-23). The purification of these items by fire underscores their consecration and the importance of holiness in their use. The destruction and removal of brass temple furnishings by the Chaldeans (2 Kings 25:13-15) highlight both the material's durability and its sacred role, while also indicating its inferior value compared to gold and silver. These verses collectively demonstrate brass as a metal of practical and spiritual significance, integral to the worship and commerce of the biblical world.
